published.title: The Ark Captured and Returned
published.summary: Israel loses the ark to the Philistines, and Eli and his sons die. The ark brings plagues on Philistine cities and is sent back on a cart to Beth-shemesh. The men of Kirjath-jearim then take it to Abinadab’s house.
